ops.does: Build map customer id -> city from T_CUST_CLEAN (this run's output)
implicit: Values[k] := '' deletes the key, so a customer with empty city is simply absent
table read as Tables.out(T_CUST_CLEAN), no ORDER BY: later duplicate id overwrites

ops.does: For every T_ORDER_AMT row: city lookup, '(UNKNOWN)' when empty, count+1, total += StrToCurr(AMOUNT)
implicit: Acc is a sorted TStringList (FPC CaseSensitive default False: IndexOf/duplicates compare case-insensitively) with dupIgnore
StrToCurr parses the '.' decimal text written by ETL-002

first-seen spelling (in T_ORDER_AMT order) is the stored key when two spellings merge; order = case-insensitive compare of the cleaned city (observed C01: (UNKNOWN), ASCII, ZüRICH, then CJK, i.e. code point order); a TreeMap with String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER differs for non-ASCII

ops.does: Drop and create T_CITY_SUM (CITY TEXT, ORDER_CNT INTEGER, TOTAL TEXT)
implicit: output table through Tables.out, including DDL

ops.does: Insert one row per city in sorted order: city, count, CurrToStrF(total, ffFixed, 2)
implicit: ffFixed 2 rounds the Currency to 2 decimals (half away from zero on the 4-decimal value), no thousand separator
city order = the sorted TStringList order (case-insensitive compare, see OP-02)
